name: Xela S1 - RNG state
description: Random generator and shared sampling helpers

name: Xela S3 - Discrete and categorical distributions
description: Discrete and categorical samplers; requires S1

name: Xela S4 - Correlation and marginal transformations
description: Correlated sampling and marginal transformations; requires S1

name: Xela WRDS1 - WRDS connection initialisation
description: Creates the shared WRDS connection; run once before the other WRDS modules in the same notebook

name: Xela WRDS2 - CRSP stock prices
description: Pulls CRSP prices, shares outstanding, market caps, and company identifiers; filters by exchanges, minimum market cap in USD, dates, and optional PERMNOs; supports daily, monthly, and yearly observations; requires WRDS1

name: Xela WRDS3 - Compustat security data
description: Pulls Compustat security prices and shares linked to PERMNOs through dated CCM links; filters by exchanges, minimum market cap, dates, and optional PERMNOs; supports field selection and daily, monthly, or yearly observations; requires WRDS1

name: Xela WRDS4 - CRSP stock returns
description: Pulls CRSP returns with optional delisting adjustments enabled by default; filters by exchanges, minimum market cap in millions of USD, dates, and optional PERMNOs; supports daily, monthly, and compounded yearly returns; requires WRDS1
